propositions: A `recheck-review` comment token allows contributors to manually re-trigger LLM-Review on changes with coverage-gap vetoes (llm-unavailable, review-error, scanner, indeterminate, gate-disabled, merge-review, or retries-exhausted escalation) without pushing a new patch set.

A `recheck-review` comment on a change with a current-revision findings-BLOCK tag must be refused with a reply message and no enqueue, vote change, or budget reset to prevent dice-rolled self-approval of real findings.

The retrigger eligibility check reads the bot's authoritative current-revision message tag from Gerrit REST API (`GET /a/changes/{id}/messages`), parses all three production tag shapes including the in-tag `(merge-change, …)` suffix, and fails open (accepts retry) on unparseable or absent tags.

The retrigger path resets the 0347 per-revision retry budget via `dedup.reset_attempts()`, enqueues via the existing `_rebar_force` machinery, and posts a message-only reply with no `labels` key to avoid vote displacement.
Comments authored by the bot itself or lacking the `recheck-review` token are silently skipped; bot-authored comments never trigger to prevent infinite reply loops.
The `/rerun` operator endpoint must also reset the attempts budget before enqueueing to harmonize with the contributor retrigger semantics and re-arm bounded automatic retries.
